--ac-bias.label: AC bias
--ac-bias.description: Strength of the RD bias toward high-frequency error, from 0.0 to 8.0. Helps texture and grain retention.

--adaptive-film-grain.label: Adaptive film grain
--adaptive-film-grain.description: 0 fixed block size, 1 chooses the grain block size from the frame resolution.

--aq-mode.label: Adaptive quantisation
--aq-mode.description: How adaptive quantisation distributes bits across the frame and temporal layers.

--asm.label: Assembly limit
--asm.description: Limit the instruction set the encoder may use. Unset lets it pick the fastest one this CPU supports.

--auto-tiling.label: Automatic tiling
--auto-tiling.description: Chooses tile rows and columns from the resolution. 0 off, 1 on (the encoder's own default).

--avif.label: Still-picture coding
--avif.description: Optimises the bitstream for a single still image. 0 off, 1 on.

--chroma-qm-max.label: Maximum chroma QM level
--chroma-qm-max.description: Most detailed chroma quantisation matrix level from 0 to 15.

--chroma-qm-min.label: Minimum chroma QM level
--chroma-qm-min.description: Flattest chroma quantisation matrix level from 0 to 15.

--color-format.label: Colour format
--color-format.description: Chroma format of the output. 4:4:4 keeps the most colour detail.

--complex-hvs.label: Complex HVS model
--complex-hvs.description: Uses the highest-complexity HVS model for rate-distortion decisions. 0 off, 1 on.

--crf.label: Constant Rate Factor
--crf.description: Constant rate factor from 1 to 70 in 0.25 steps. Lower keeps more detail; equivalent to --rc 0 --aq-mode 2 --qp.

--enable-cdef.label: CDEF
--enable-cdef.description: 0 off, 1 on (the encoder's own default). Constrained directional enhancement filter.

--enable-dg.label: Dynamic GOP
--enable-dg.description: 0 off, 1 adapts the hierarchical structure to the content.

--enable-dlf.label: Deblocking filter
--enable-dlf.description: 0 off, 1 enabled, 2 and 3 slower but more accurate filtering.

--enable-overlays.label: Overlay pictures
--enable-overlays.description: 0 off, 1 inserts overlayer pictures as an additional reference for the base layer.

--enable-qm.label: Quantisation matrices
--enable-qm.description: 0 off, 1 on (the encoder's own default). Uses adaptive quantisation matrices.

--enable-restoration.label: Loop restoration
--enable-restoration.description: 0 off, 1 on (the encoder's own default). Enables the loop restoration filter.

--enable-stat-report.label: PSNR/SSIM report
--enable-stat-report.description: 0 off, 1 prints PSNR and SSIM at the end of the encode.

--enable-tf.label: Temporal filtering
--enable-tf.description: 0 off, 1 on, 2 and 3 adaptive with a stronger filter.

--enable-variance-boost.label: Variance boost
--enable-variance-boost.description: 0 off, 1 on (the encoder's own default). Improves texture and grain retention.

--fast-decode.label: Fast decode
--fast-decode.description: 0 off; 1 and 2 trade compression for decoder speed.

--film-grain.label: Film grain synthesis
--film-grain.description: Synthesise grain at this strength from 1 to 50 instead of encoding source grain; 0 disables it.

--film-grain-denoise.label: Denoise before grain
--film-grain-denoise.description: 0 keeps source grain in the frame header, 1 derives the denoise level from the grain strength. Only applies when film grain is on.

--gop-constraint-rc.label: GOP-constrained rate control
--gop-constraint-rc.description: Matches the target bitrate within each GOP instead of across the whole encode. 0 off, 1 on.

--hierarchical-levels.label: Hierarchical levels
--hierarchical-levels.description: Temporal layers beyond the base layer, from 2 to 5.

--input-depth.label: Input bit depth
--input-depth.description: Bits per sample of the frames handed to the encoder.

--irefresh-type.label: Intra refresh type
--irefresh-type.description: Forward frame keeps an open GOP; key frame starts a closed GOP.

--keyint.label: Keyframe interval
--keyint.description: Maximum GOP length in frames. -2 is about 5 seconds, -1 is infinite (CRF only), 0 is the same as -1.

--level.label: Level
--level.description: AV1 level such as 5.1; 0 chooses it automatically.

--lookahead.label: Lookahead
--lookahead.description: Frames to look ahead beyond the mini-GOP, temporal filtering and rate control; -1 is automatic.

--low-memory.label: Low memory
--low-memory.description: Reduces memory use at a possible speed and efficiency cost; most effective in CRF or CQP random-access mode. 0 off, 1 on.

--lp.label: Level of parallelism
--lp.description: 0 chooses from the core count; 1 to 6 create more threads and picture buffers.

--luminance-qp-bias.label: Luminance QP bias
--luminance-qp-bias.description: Adjust a frame's QP from its average luma, 0 to 100.

--mbr.label: Maximum bitrate
--mbr.description: Maximum bitrate in kbps for capped CRF; b, k and m suffixes are accepted.

--min-keyint.label: Minimum keyframe interval
--min-keyint.description: Shortest GOP in frames; -1 derives it from the mini-GOP length and 0 removes the minimum.

--passes.label: Passes
--passes.description: 1 single pass, 2 multi-pass. The engine also sets the pass for each run.

--photon-noise-chroma.label: Chroma photon noise
--photon-noise-chroma.description: Adds chroma noise to the photon-noise table. 0 off, 1 on.

--preset.label: Encoder preset
--preset.description: Encoder preset from -1 (slowest) to 13 (fastest). Higher presets encode faster with a quality trade-off.

--profile.label: Profile
--profile.description: Bitstream profile written to the sequence header.

--qm-max.label: Maximum QM level
--qm-max.description: Most detailed quantisation matrix level from 0 to 15.

--qm-min.label: Minimum QM level
--qm-min.description: Flattest quantisation matrix level from 0 to 15; lower is more aggressive.

--qp.label: Quantiser
--qp.description: Initial QP from 1 to 63, used by constant-QP mode and as the base for CRF.

--qp-scale-compress-strength.label: QP scale compress
--qp-scale-compress-strength.description: Compress QP variation across temporal layers, 0 to 8; higher is more consistent.

--rc.label: Rate-control mode
--rc.description: CRF keeps quality constant; VBR and CBR target a bitrate.

--rtc.label: Real-time mode
--rtc.description: Fast settings for low-delay real-time encoding; forces the low-delay prediction structure. 0 off, 1 on.

--scd.label: Scene-change detection
--scd.description: Start a new GOP at a detected scene cut.

--scm.label: Screen-content detection
--scm.description: 0 off, 1 on, 2 content adaptive, 3 content adaptive with anti-alias awareness.

--sharp-tx.label: Sharp transform
--sharp-tx.description: Enables the sharp transform optimisation. 0 off, 1 on.

--sharpness.label: Sharpness
--sharpness.description: Bias toward decreased (-7) or increased (7) sharpness.

--startup-mg-size.label: Startup mini-GOP size
--startup-mg-size.description: 0 off, 2 three temporal layers, 3 four temporal layers, 4 five temporal layers.

--svtav1-params.label: SVT-AV1 parameters
--svtav1-params.description: Colon-separated key=value pairs for options that have no dedicated flag here.

--tbr.label: Target bitrate
--tbr.description: Target bitrate in kbps for VBR and CBR; b, k and m suffixes are accepted.

--tf-strength.label: Temporal filtering strength
--tf-strength.description: Manually set motion-compensated temporal filtering strength, 0 to 4; higher is stronger.

--tile-columns.label: Tile columns
--tile-columns.description: Log2 number of tile columns from 0 to 4; 0 keeps one column.

--tile-rows.label: Tile rows
--tile-rows.description: Log2 number of tile rows from 0 to 6; 0 keeps one row.

--tune.label: Tune
--tune.description: Quality metric the encoder optimises for.

--aq-mode.label: Adaptive quantisation
--aq-mode.description: 0 off, 1 variance, 2 auto-variance, 3 auto-variance with bias.

--crf.label: CRF
--crf.description: Constant rate factor from 0 (lossless) to 51. Lower keeps more detail.

--keyint.label: Keyframe interval
--keyint.description: Maximum GOP length in frames; -1 lets the encoder choose.

--tune.label: Tune
--tune.description: psnr, ssim, grain, zerolatency, fastdecode or animation.

--y4m.label: Y4M input
--y4m.description: Read the input as a raw Y4M stream.

-D.label: Output depth
-D.description: Bits per sample in the output, 8, 10 or 12.
